Dear Emeline Bodin,

Problem Description
: Need Logs Information
Resolution
: The logs for the mentioned time is not available in AWS as well as in Siemens backend, there might be possibility that the charger is in power off state or shutdown state. The logs that attached in the ticket is what we fetch from the charger.
If you need any further assistance, please do reach back out to us by submitting a new request at
www.siemens.com/emobility-service-request
Kindly note that email responses to closed tickets are not monitored.
Thank you.
